verdict.rationale: Modal's docs say developers can 'spin up fresh, isolated sandboxes programmatically' through the Python, JS and Go SDKs, including creating a Sandbox with a specified image in code. The 'in seconds' claim appears only in vendor marketing, and community posts confirm people build on the SDK but not how fast sandboxes start. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on measurement of sandbox startup latency, and a verbatim single-call creation snippet in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds

citations.quote: Spin up fresh, isolated sandboxes programmatically.
